Install the lgr Skill File into a Project

Source: R/use_skill.R
use_skill.Rd

Copies the SKILL.md file bundled with lgr (documenting lgr/ LoggerGlue conventions) into a coding agent's project-level skills directory, so agent tooling can discover it. Unlike use_logger(), which only prints code for you to paste, use_skill() writes the file directly: the skill file is static content meant to be dropped in unmodified, so there is nothing to review or merge first.

Usage

use_skill(agent = NULL, path = NULL, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

agent

character scalar. One of the supported agent presets ("claude", "cline", "codex", "cursor", "gemini", "github-copilot", "windsurf"), naming which agent's convention to install to. If NULL (the default) and path is also NULL, the target is auto-detected (see Details). Ignored if path is supplied.

path

character scalar. A custom destination, overriding both agent and auto-detection. May point at a directory (in which case SKILL.md is appended) or directly at a destination file. An existing directory is always treated as a directory; otherwise a path with a file extension (e.g. ending in .md) is treated as the literal destination file, and a path without an extension is treated as a directory to create.

overwrite

logical scalar. If FALSE (the default) and the destination file already exists, use_skill() leaves it untouched and reports that it did so. Set to TRUE to replace an existing file.

Value

invisible(TRUE) if a file was written (fresh write or overwrite), invisible(FALSE) if the write was skipped because the destination already existed and overwrite = FALSE.

Details

The same SKILL.md file is copied verbatim to every supported agent. This is deliberate rather than an oversight: Claude Code, Cline, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Windsurf all implement the open Agent Skills standard (a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter, installed at <tool-dir>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md), which is explicitly designed so that the same file works unmodified across tools.

If agent and path are both NULL (the default), use_skill() looks for existing config directories belonging to the supported agents, in this priority order: "claude" first, then the rest alphabetically ("cline", "codex", "cursor", "gemini", "github-copilot", "windsurf"). If exactly one is found, the file is installed for that agent. If several are found, the highest-priority one is used. If none are found, use_skill() falls back to the "claude" convention, since it is this package's primary target and several other tools already treat it as one of their own fallback locations. Either way, use_skill() always reports what it found and which target it chose before writing anything.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# auto-detect based on existing agent config directories
use_skill()

# force a specific agent
use_skill(agent = "cursor")

# install to a custom location
use_skill(path = "tools/agent-config")
} # }
